fluff.overview: The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery assigns conventional infantry to garrison roles across its military districts, with district regulars often fielding extra platoons to secure worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently garrison. Wheeled mechanized infantry ride armored personnel carriers that offer speed on roads and enough protection to survive initial contact. The DCMS assigns these platoons where garrison duty demands both rapid response and the ability to dismount under fire, a combination that foot and motorized troops cannot reliably deliver. Their support squads operate portable machine guns that deliver sustained automatic fire at ranges well beyond personal weapons. A single well-placed machine gun team can suppress an entire enemy platoon and threaten light vehicles that would otherwise ignore conventional infantry.
